latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of approved-self-improvement skill for OpenClaw and compatible agents. Your agent is self learning, self healing but wont apply any skill fixes without your approval unless set to auto approve for a specific skill.

- Captures learnings, errors, and user-requested features in structured markdown files for continuous improvement.
- All skill changes require explicit user approval unless auto-update is authorized for that skill.
- Provides quick reference table for when and where to log events (errors, corrections, feature requests, knowledge gaps, best practices).
- Includes setup instructions for OpenClaw (recommended) and generic agent platforms.
- Supports promotion of broadly useful learnings to workspace-wide knowledge files.
- Optional hook integration for automatic reminders and session start assistance.
